messages.subject: [D-RUG] First virtual meeting tomorrow (10/2) from 10-12
parts:
Hi All,

Welcome back to a very strange Fall term! We coordinators of Davis R Users Group are working hard to move D-RUG to a virtual platform this Fall, as we know your R questions don't stop during a smokey pandemic! 

Every Friday this term from 10-12PDT, we will be hosting a virtual work group on zoom (link below). D-RUG coordinators and other R-savvy folks will be virtually waiting to answer any questions or help work through a R problem. Stay tuned for announcements about virtual presentations this term!

If you are unable to attend our zoom work group, please post any questions on our discourse site, which is a great resource to view past questions, check out presentations, and learn more about the D-RUG community. 

Thanks all! 
D-RUG Coordinators
